panels.title: Active Alerts (Critical)
panels.description: Number of currently active alerts at **critical** severity, from Alertmanager's `ALERTS` metric (exposed by Prometheus). A non-zero value means something needs immediate attention.

panels.title: Active Alerts (Warning)
panels.description: Number of currently active alerts at **warning** severity, from Alertmanager's `ALERTS` metric. Warning-level alerts are significant but not necessarily urgent.

panels.title: Total Active Alerts
panels.description: Sum of all active alerts across all severities, from the `ALERTS` metric surfaced by Alertmanager. Includes both critical and warning.

panels.title: Total Silences
panels.description: Count of active silences in Alertmanager, from `alertmanager_silences`. Silences suppress notifications for matching alerts for a defined window.

panels.title: Alerts by Severity
panels.description: Distribution of active alerts grouped by severity (critical / warning), from `ALERTS` by (severity). Shows the relative weight of critical vs warning issues.

panels.title: Alerts by Name
panels.description: Active alert count grouped by alert name, from `ALERTS` by (alertname). Helps identify which specific alert rules are currently firing.

panels.title: Alert History (last 24h)
panels.description: Hourly rate of alert state changes (firings) over the last 24 hours, from `alertmanager_alerts_total` increase by alertname. Shows alert activity trends, not current state.

panels.title: Alertmanager Uptime
panels.description: Whether the Alertmanager instance is reachable, from the standard Prometheus `up{job="alertmanager"}` metric. 1 = up, 0 = down.

panels.title: Alertmanager Memory
panels.description: Working set memory usage of the Alertmanager container, from cAdvisor/container metrics `container_memory_working_set_bytes`. Tracked per pod.

panels.title: Alertmanager CPU
panels.description: CPU usage rate of the Alertmanager container, from `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total`. Shown per pod.

panels.title: Pending Alerts
panels.description: Number of alerts queued and waiting to be sent by Alertmanager, from `pending_alertmanager_alerts`. High values may indicate a notification bottleneck.

panels.title: Notification Rate
panels.description: Rate of notifications sent by Alertmanager, broken down by integration (e.g. email, Slack, PagerDuty), from `alertmanager_notifications_total`.

panels.title: Notifications Failed
panels.description: Rate of failed notifications from Alertmanager, from `alertmanager_notifications_failed_total`. Non-zero means some notifications are not reaching their recipients.
